plugin.name: Second Sight Widescreen Fix
ResX.description: Width in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
ResY.description: Height in pixels. Zero selects the desktop resolution. Restart required.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the corrected field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Wider views may reveal through-wall rendering in some locations.
